files.content: "use client" import { RadialBar, RadialBarChart } from "recharts" import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "./card" import { ChartContainer, ChartTooltip, ChartTooltipContent } from "./chart" const chartData = [ { channel: "direct", visitors: 275, fill: "var(--chart-1)" }, { channel: "search", visitors: 200, fill: "var(--chart-2)" }, { channel: "referral", visitors: 187, fill: "var(--chart-3)" }, { channel: "email", visitors: 173, fill: "var(--chart-4)" }, { channel: "other", visitors: 90, fill: "var(--chart-5)" }, ] const chartConfig = { visitors: { label: "Visitors" }, direct: { label: "Direct", color: "var(--chart-1)" }, search: { label: "Search", color: "var(--chart-2)" }, referral: { label: "Referral", color: "var(--chart-3)" }, email: { label: "Email", color: "var(--chart-4)" }, other: { label: "Other", color: "var(--chart-5)" }, } /** Mallow radial chart: rounded rings on recessed tracks, one per channel. */ export function ChartRadialDefault() { return ( Visitors by channel January to June } /> Largest channel Direct, 275 ) }
